note: ADR 1018: the legal programs whose checker violation sits at a site no run reaches (legal.mjs outcome `unexecuted`) that a person has seen. Such a row needs a look (codes.mjs `rowProblem`: `unexecuted-violation`) unless an entry below matches its grid and id: `explained` (the judge is right that the site never runs and the row is not a checker defect, a lane that never drives the site, say) or `pending-fix` (a real false positive whose fix is the ADR named, held so CI stays green until it lands; the fix's change removes the entry). A provably dead site gives U, never V (ADR 1018 retires the 2026-11-10 "wrong if it runs" ruling). Seeded from the full audit at 78ddeb849 (run 43739577046): 6,205 rows in lg-recall, four groups, each Chrome-confirmed on 993e83f74.

ADR 1019 left the DOM carriers out; the #270 smoke (run 44001094191) found 6 rows once the tbl-zero entry left. Fix owner: Mac 20.
